issue.title: master->master warm reboot fails because of pending tasks in the queue

failure.body:
**Description**
We see on some platforms that warm reboot fails the RESTARTCHECK due to pending tasks on ports that have been disabled in the system.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Configure a platform w/ 2 ports that are oper and admin down.
2. `sudo warm-reboot`

**Describe the results you received:**
```
admin@str2-7050cx3-acs-03:~$ sudo warm-reboot
RESTARTCHECK failed
admin@str2-7050cx3-acs-03:~$ sudo grep orchagent /var/log/syslog

Jan 26 <IPV6>.012126 str2-7050cx3-acs-03 NOTICE swss#orchagent_restart_check: :- main: Wait time for response from orchagent set to 2000 milliseconds
Jan 26 <IPV6>.012126 str2-7050cx3-acs-03 NOTICE swss#orchagent_restart_check: :- main: Number of retries for the request to orchagent is set to 5
Jan 26 <IPV6>.012765 str2-7050cx3-acs-03 INFO swss#orchagent_restart_check: :- subscribe: subscribed to RESTARTCHECKREPLY
Jan 26 <IPV6>.012765 str2-7050cx3-acs-03 NOTICE swss#orchagent_restart_check: :- main: requested orchagent to do warm restart state check, retry count: 0
Jan 26 <IPV6>.013020 str2-7050cx3-acs-03 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- doTask: RESTARTCHECK notification for orchagent
Jan 26 <IPV6>.013020 str2-7050cx3-acs-03 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- doTask: orchagent|NoFreeze:false|SkipPendingTaskCheck:false
Jan 26 <IPV6>.013344 str2-7050cx3-acs-03 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- warmRestartCheck: WarmRestart check found pending tasks:
Jan 26 <IPV6>.013344 str2-7050cx3-acs-03 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- warmRestartCheck:     PORT_TABLE:Ethernet128|SET|alias:Ethernet33|description:Ethernet33|fec:rs|index:33|lanes:129|pfc_asym:off|speed:100000|mtu:9100|admin_status:down
Jan 26 <IPV6>.013368 str2-7050cx3-acs-03 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- warmRestartCheck:     PORT_TABLE:Ethernet132|SET|alias:Ethernet34|description:Ethernet34|fec:rs|index:34|lanes:128|pfc_asym:off|speed:100000|mtu:9100|admin_status:down
Jan 26 <IPV6>.013387 str2-7050cx3-acs-03 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- warmRestartCheck: Restart check result: NOT_READY
Jan 26 <IPV6>.013538 str2-7050cx3-acs-03 NOTICE swss#orchagent_restart_check: :- main: RESTARTCHECK failed, orchagent is not ready for warm restart with status NOT_READY
Jan 26 <IPV6>.013538 str2-7050cx3-acs-03 NOTICE swss#orchagent_restart_check: :- main: requested orchagent to do warm restart state check, retry count: 1
```

**Describe the results you expected:**
Warm boot should succeed.

resolution.title: [port_config.ini] 7050CX3-32S-C32: Remove unused 10G ports and update speed
resolution.description:
`port_config.ini` for HWSKU `Arista-7050CX3-32S-C32` has missing speed column and duplicated lanes.
The incorrect speed causes issues in Orchagent RESTARTCHECK as the below task remains as the remaining item during swss shutdown.

**- Why I did it**
Fixes: https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/6569

**- How I did it**
Updated port_config.ini file with speed, and removed duplicated lanes.

**- How to verify it**
Generated new minigraph, and installed it on a 7050CX3 device, the RESTARTCHECK passes and warm-reboot proceeds.
